sections.name: synthesizeCohort
sections.title: Reviewing a large industry in batches
sections.what: Reviews an industry's projects in groups of 40, keeps the most representative ones from each group, and repeats until 40 or fewer remain. It then writes one final highlight summary from those. The summary still says how many projects were reviewed in total.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps AI requests within limits while still reviewing every project in the industry.
sections.watch_out: Any single failed batch throws an error and the whole synthesis must be retried.

summary: Reduces a large industry to a smaller set of representative projects by having the AI review them in batches, then writes one highlight summary from those.
purpose: Lets an AI review a whole industry without exceeding model request limits, while still producing one executive summary.
why: The code comment says the work is split into bounded requests to limit load on the AI provider, and a batch size of 40 is set. Likely reason: a whole industry is too large for one request.
how: 1. Sort projects by id for a stable order. 2. While more than 40 remain, split them into batches of 40. Two workers review batches at once. From each batch, keep the projects the AI names, up to 8, or one project if none are named. 3. Repeat until 40 or fewer remain. 4. Run the final summary on the remaining candidates, while the title still states the total number of reviewed projects.
inputs: The industry code and name, the list of project data for the industry, and a run id.
outputs: A synthesis result from the AI summary function. Throws an error if any batch fails.
risks: One failed batch stops the whole synthesis and the run must be retried. Matching projects by lowercased name can pick the wrong project when two share a name. The final summary is based only on the selected candidates, not every project.
debug: If a run stops with a message about a batch failing, check the AI model configuration and provider status, then retry synthesis. If the summary seems to leave projects out, check whether project names in the AI reply match the stored names after lowercasing.
